unchanged: Qwen3.5-397B backbone for source writer/binder/shadow/final policy

changed_variable.from: a Qwen397 branch-blind memory-blind model call chooses one read-only state-reveal shell command
changed_variable.to: a deterministic outcome-blind task-guided compiler constructs one bounded read-only repository probe; no model call is used for state reveal

rationale: The scientific purpose of MSR is to expose identical repository state to both memory branches, not to test another action-selection policy. A model-selected probe would introduce unnecessary stochasticity and a second policy-selection surface. Deterministic compilation strengthens the matched-state intervention and makes the G0-vs-Gplus contrast closer to a single-variable test.

compiler.input: future task text only; no source trajectory, writer memory, branch label, outcome, gold patch, evaluator result, or model output
compiler.token_candidates: backticked/code-like identifiers first, then identifier-like lexical tokens; fixed stoplist; deterministic deduplication
compiler.token_ranking: candidate class priority, then SHA256(C1-PACTA-MSR-PROBE-TOKEN-v1|future_task_sha256|token), then token
compiler.command_template: git status --short; git grep -n -I -e <token1> -e <token2> -e <token3> -- . | head -n 80; git ls-files | head -n 40
compiler.quoting: Python shlex.quote on every selected token
compiler.execution: future exact-digest image after exact-base normalization, with no memory injected
compiler.observation_binding: exact command bytes/hash and exact stdout+returncode bytes/hash are copied identically into both branch decision contexts

failure_policy: If the deterministic probe cannot be compiled or executed for any selected pilot unit, stop before writer/shadow method evaluation; do not substitute a different probe after seeing branch outcomes.
claim_boundary: MSR is a matched state-acquisition intervention. It does not claim state-aware memory or generic action probing as novel; the novelty residual remains the paired writer-counterfactual transport test at an exactly matched revealed state.
